title: Every proposal carries its rationale, and no EXECUTE_SAFE is issued without its record

context.task: The v0.1 is presented as 'work records for coding agents: every action leaves a record that it happened, and why'. Today the record of a proposal holds its intent class, file, decision and abort flag, but no reason, and an EXECUTE_SAFE is issued even when its record cannot be written. This task adds a required Rationale to the proposal, records it with every decision taken on a valid proposal, and issues no EXECUTE_SAFE without its record.

problem: The audit trail is meant to be the record of what an agent did and why, but a proposal has no field for why: audit_log stores case_id, timestamp, intent_class, target_file, decision and safety_abort. The record can also be missing behind an EXECUTE_SAFE: _persist_audit swallows every sqlite3.Error (AGENTS 8.4), the audit row and the receipt are written in two separate connections, and test_the_validator_fails_open_when_the_audit_database_cannot_be_written pins an EXECUTE_SAFE for a database that cannot be written. Adding a column to audit_log has a further trap: an existing database (this repository's .data/ and every installed target) has the old table, so a plain INSERT with the new column would fail and, under the swallowed error, every row would be lost without a word.
decisions: D1 AgentMutationProposal gains a required field Rationale: a string of 1 to 1000 characters that contains at least one character that is not whitespace. Its schema description says what it is for: why the change is made, in words the person who reads the record understands; it is recorded with the decision, and nothing checks that it is true. It is required like the other fields, so build_response_format and the MCP inputSchema, both generated from the model, list it among the required properties; no schema is written by hand.

D2 A proposal without Rationale, or with one that is not a string, is empty, is only whitespace or is longer than 1000 characters, is a schema violation: INVALID_JSON, exactly as any other schema violation today, and no receipt. A NUL inside it stays ABORTED_VIOLATES_ZERO_TRUST through the existing check.

D3 audit_log gains a column `rationale TEXT`. Every decision taken on a proposal that passed the schema records its Rationale there byte for byte, the refusals included (Safety_Abort other than NONE, target mismatch, grounding failure, a primitive or a parse failure of a .py result). A decision taken before the schema passes (a NUL, invalid JSON, a schema violation) records NULL.

D4 An audit database whose audit_log lacks the column is migrated in place by the validator before its next write (ALTER TABLE audit_log ADD COLUMN rationale TEXT), keeping every row it has. The hook keeps opening the database read-only and does not change: the receipts table keeps its columns, and a receipt reaches its rationale through its case_id.

D5 An EXECUTE_SAFE exists only with its record: its audit_log row, with the rationale, and its receipts row are written in one SQLite transaction. When that transaction fails, neither row remains and the validator returns {"status": "QUARANTINED", "final_decision": "ABORTED_NOT_RECORDED", "case_id": <the case id>, "reason": "the audit trail could not be written, so no receipt was issued"}; the reason carries no path.

D6 A refusal whose audit row cannot be written is still returned as it is, and the failure is written to stderr as one line that starts with `[boundary-validator]` and carries no path; it is no longer silenced (AGENTS 8.4). stdout stays the JSON-RPC channel.

D7 test_the_validator_fails_open_when_the_audit_database_cannot_be_written pins the behaviour D5 removes. It changes to expect ABORTED_NOT_RECORDED and no receipt, under a name that says so. This is a change of the specification made by this contract, not a test changed to hide a failure (AGENTS 8.2).

D8 _persist_receipt(case_id, target_file, grounding_sha256, block_sha256) keeps its signature, because tests plant receipts with it. _persist_audit keeps its five positional parameters and gains a sixth, rationale, that defaults to None. Any new helper for the transaction of D5 is private to validator.py.
D9 The hook (tools/hooks/require_boundary_validation.py), hook_gate.py and primitives.py do not change.

D10 Every text that tells an agent how to build a proposal names Rationale: AGENTS.md 2.2; both copies of the boundary-validator skill, which stay byte for byte identical (tests/unit/test_agent_docs.py), with Rationale in their description and their list of fields and ABORTED_NOT_RECORDED after EXECUTE_SAFE in their list of outcomes; both copies of the tdd-cycle skill, identical too; .claude/agents/implementer.md, with one sentence saying that the Rationale says why the change is made, in a sentence a person can read; the description of TOOL_DEFINITION; and the docstring of AgentMutationProposal. In those texts, and only there, '5 Radicals' becomes 'the proposal schema', because the fields are no longer five. Test docstrings, docs/ and examples/ keep their wording.

D11 Every existing test that builds a proposal adds a Rationale to it, so that its expectation stays exactly as it is (AGENTS 6.4). They are the files in files_may_touch under tests/ other than tests/security/test_rationale.py. Nothing else changes in them, except the test of D7. The new tests go in tests/security/test_rationale.py.

D12 During this task the session's boundary-validator server is the one that started with the session, on the base commit's code: the proposals you send it keep the base schema, without Rationale, or it refuses them as INVALID_JSON. Do not restart or reconnect it. Every test runs the new code in its own process and its own audit database (isolate_audit_db, tmp_path); none touches .data/.
D13 No new dependency and no new network, process or code-loading primitive; sqlite3 as today.

D14 Gates: red-first, each red test seen failing for its stated reason before the change that makes it pass; full-suite, `pytest tests/` exits 0 at the commit; verify-red-green, tools/audit/verify_red_green.py exits 0 on the report.

behaviours.statement: A proposal that is valid today and also carries a Rationale gets EXECUTE_SAFE, and the audit_log row of its case_id holds that Rationale byte for byte.
A proposal without Rationale, or with "", with "  \n\t", with 1001 characters or with a number, gets INVALID_JSON and no receipt; a Rationale of exactly 1000 characters passes.

A proposal that passes the schema and is then refused (Safety_Abort BOUNDARY_VIOLATION, a target mismatch, a grounding failure, a primitive in a .py result) records its Rationale in its audit_log row; a proposal refused as INVALID_JSON records NULL.
build_response_format(AgentMutationProposal) and the inputSchema that tools/list returns over the MCP server list Rationale among the required properties of the proposal.

An audit database created with the base commit's tables (audit_log without the rationale column, holding rows, and receipts) is migrated by the next validation: its old rows keep their values, the new row holds its rationale, and the hook still finds the new receipt in it.
When the audit database cannot be written, the validator returns ABORTED_NOT_RECORDED with no path in its reason, and the database holds no receipt and no EXECUTE_SAFE row for that case.
When the receipt cannot be inserted after the audit row (a receipts table that rejects the insert), neither the audit row nor the receipt remains, and the decision is ABORTED_NOT_RECORDED.
AGENTS.md 2.2, both boundary-validator skills and .claude/agents/implementer.md name Rationale; every property of AgentMutationProposal is named in AGENTS.md 2.2 and in the boundary-validator skill.
A receipt planted with _persist_receipt still lets the hook allow exactly its Edit and nothing else, as today.

tests.must_catch: a proposal accepted without a Rationale, or with an empty, blank, non-string or over-long one; or a 1000-character one refused
tests.reason: at base the schema has no Rationale: a proposal that carries one is INVALID_JSON as an extra field, and one without it is EXECUTE_SAFE

tests.must_catch: an EXECUTE_SAFE or a refusal after the schema whose audit row does not hold the proposal's Rationale, or an INVALID_JSON row that holds anything but NULL
tests.reason: at base audit_log has no rationale column

tests.must_catch: a strict response format or an MCP inputSchema that does not require Rationale
tests.reason: at base the model has no Rationale property

tests.must_catch: an old audit database that loses its rows, is not migrated, or stops serving receipts to the hook
tests.reason: at base a proposal with a Rationale is refused, so no new row with its rationale lands in the old database

tests.must_catch: an EXECUTE_SAFE issued when its record cannot be written, or a reason that names a path
tests.reason: at base the validator swallows the error and returns EXECUTE_SAFE, as the test of D7 pins

tests.must_catch: an audit row left behind when its receipt cannot be inserted
tests.reason: at base the audit row is committed in its own connection before the receipt is attempted

tests.must_catch: a text that tells an agent how to build a proposal without naming Rationale, or a property of the model missing from AGENTS.md 2.2 or the skill
tests.reason: at base neither the model nor any of those texts has Rationale

tests.must_catch: a change in how the hook matches a receipt planted with _persist_receipt
tests.reason: the hook and the receipts table do not change, so this already holds at base and must keep holding

commit_message: feat(validador): cada propuesta lleva su motivo, y no hay EXECUTE_SAFE sin su acta
